title: Beyond the Black Box: Measuring UXR Impact | Great Question
summary: Pedro Vargas on the “black box” problem that makes measuring UX research impact so challenging and how to use “impact boxes” to overcome this in your org.
body_markdown: Pedro Vargas is a Brazilian researcher, mentor and teacher. A content creator for thousands of professionals, he has a postgraduate degree in Business Management and Marketing and is UX Certified by the Nielsen Norman Group, with an emphasis on UX Management. He teaches and learns about ResearchOps and UX Research in his classes and has worked in youth entrepreneurship initiatives all over the world.
